faqs.q: How do I calculate my annual salary from an hourly rate as a teacher aide in QLD?
faqs.a: Multiply your hourly rate by the number of hours you work each week, then by 52. If you work 38 hours per week, use: hourly rate × 38 × 52. faqs.q: Does the teacher aide salary QLD include casual loading and super?

bodyMarkdown:
## Understanding Your Teacher Aide Salary in Queensland

If you are a teacher aide in Queensland, you may be paid by the hour or offered a salary. Converting between the two helps you compare job offers and understand your annual earnings. This guide explains how to convert an hourly rate to annual pay, using the standard 38-hour week, and covers tax, super, and the difference between minimum wages, award rates, and averages.

### The Basic Formula: Hourly × Hours × 52

The standard way to estimate annual gross pay is:

**Annual gross ≈ hourly rate × hours per week × 52 weeks**

If you work 38 hours each week (the ordinary full-time hours used by the Fair Work Commission), the formula becomes:

**Annual gross = hourly rate × 38 × 52**

For example, if your hourly rate is $30.00, your annual gross would be $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280 before tax and super. This assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice.

### Teacher Aide Salary QLD: Award Rates and Minimums

Teacher aides in Queensland are often covered by the *Educational Services (Schools) General Staff Award 2020*. This award sets minimum hourly rates based on classification levels. The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour for a permanent employee, or $33.05 per hour for a casual (including 25% loading). However, award rates for teacher aides may be higher than the national minimum. You should check your specific classification in the award or your employment contract.

If you are a casual teacher aide, your hourly rate already includes a 25% casual loading. When using the conversion formula, enter the base rate (without loading) if you are permanent, or the loaded rate if you are casual. Never add casual loading on top of a rate that already includes it.

### Queensland Average Earnings: A Reference, Not a Median

The Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) reports that full-time adult ordinary-time earnings in Queensland were $2,039.70 per week in May 2026. This is an average across all occupations and industries, not a median for teacher aides. Your own pay may be higher or lower depending on your employer, experience, and classification. Use this figure as a broad comparison, not as a target for your salary.

### Fortnightly Pay and Budgeting

Many employers pay fortnightly. To estimate your fortnightly gross pay, multiply your weekly pay by 2. For a 38-hour week at $30 per hour, weekly pay is $1,140, so fortnightly is $2,280. This can help you budget and compare with salary offers that are quoted per fortnight.

### Tax on Your Teacher Aide Salary

For the 2026–27 income year, the Australian Tax Office (ATO) resident tax rates are:

- $0 – $18,200: nil
- $18,201 – $45,000: 15%
- $45,001 – $135,000: 30%
- $135,001 – $190,000: 37%
- $190,001+: 45%

Plus a Medicare levy of generally 2% of taxable income. The tax-free threshold is included. Note that the Medicare levy reduction thresholds used here are from 2025–26 as the 2026–27 thresholds were not confirmed. Your actual tax may differ if you have HELP debt, a Medicare levy surcharge, or salary packaging.

### Superannuation: Paid on Top

Employers must pay superannuation guarantee contributions of 12% of your ordinary earnings, on top of your gross pay. This is not deducted from your hourly rate. For example, if your annual gross is $59,280, your employer adds $7,113.60 in super (up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830 per year). Super is separate from your take-home pay.

### Using the Timesheet and Other Tools

To quickly convert your hourly rate to annual, fortnightly, or weekly figures, use the [timesheet](/) on this site. Enter your base hourly rate (without casual loading if you are permanent, or with loading if you are casual). The tool will show your gross annual pay, tax estimate, and super. For more details on award rates and classifications, see the [pay guides](/blog) or [reference tables](/data).

### Important Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026–27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025–26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026–27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.

### Summary

To find your annual teacher aide salary in Queensland, start with your hourly rate, multiply by your weekly hours (often 38), then by 52. Compare your result with the Queensland average of $2,039.70 per week, but remember that is an average across all jobs. Check your award for your correct minimum rate. Use the [hourly conversion](/topics/hourly-conversion) page for more examples, and learn about [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging) to understand your total remuneration.
